description: askit-build-skill improve mode phase 2 delegates the optional craft review to askit-reviewer.

cases.given: an improve-mode run whose deterministic gate is already clean and whose user opts in to the craft review
cases.expect: askit-reviewer returns craft findings against references/skill-craft-rubric.md, the SAFE subset is offered for a consent-gated apply and the JUDGMENT remainder is reported untouched, and the gate verdict is unchanged

cases.given: an improve-mode run whose deterministic gate still reports errors
cases.expect: phase 2 is not offered and askit-reviewer is not dispatched; the run returns to phase 1
